Features

Switch Mode

Bonus Action.

As a Bonus Action, you can transform the weapon between Sword & Shield Mode and Axe Mode.

Elemental Attunement

Once per Short rest or Long rest, you can change the element attuned to this weapon.

Mastery (Sap) (Sword & Shield)

If you hit a creature, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

Mastery (Cleave) (Axe)

If you hit a creature, you can make an extra attack against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach.

Phial Charges

The weapon can hold up to 5 Phial Charges. Any unspent charges safely dissipate if you haven't made an attack with this weapon for 1 minute. The gauge starts at 0 after a Long Rest. When you hit a creature with an attack in Sword & Shield Mode, you generate 1 Phial Charge.

Guard Point (Elemental Guard)

Reaction.

You learn to perfectly time your blocks. As a Reaction when you are hit by a melee attack while in Sword & Shield Mode, you can expend 1 Phial Charge to add +2 to your AC against that attack. If this causes the attack to miss, your shield erupts, dealing [[/r 1d4]] damage of your Elemental Attunement type to the attacker.

▸ Upgrade — Guard Point Upgrade I

Your Guard Point damage increases to [[/r 1d6]].

Elemental Discharge

While in Axe Mode, the weapon becomes a conduit of raw power. When you hit a creature with an attack in Axe Mode, you can expend 1 Phial Charge to deal an extra [[/r 1d6]] damage of your Elemental Attunement type to the target.

▸ Upgrade — Elemental Discharge Upgrade I

Your Elemental Discharge (Axe hit) damage increases to [[/r 1d8]].

Amped Element Discharge (AED)

Action.

You can unleash all stored energy in one devastating shockwave. As an Action while in Axe Mode, you can expend any number of remaining Phial Charges (minimum of 1) to unleash a 15-foot cone of elemental energy. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier). A creature takes [[/r 1d8]] damage of your Elemental Attunement type per phial expended on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

▸ Upgrade — Amped Element Discharge Upgrade I

Your Amped Element Discharge (Cone) damage increases to [[/r 1d10]] per phial expended.

Charged Shield (Red Shield)

You can cycle the energy back into the weapon's defense mechanism. When you use your Amped Element Discharge Action, you can choose to cancel the shockwave to charge your shield instead. For 1 minute, your shield grants an additional +1 AC, and your Guard Point feature deals two times your Elemental Discharge elemental damage instead of its normal damage.
